seo.title: Isôoko Community Development — Guteza Imbere Urubyiruko n'Abakobwa i Masoro, mu Rwanda
seo.description: Isôoko Community Development (ICD) iteza imbere urubyiruko n'abakobwa i Masoro, mu Rwanda, binyuze mu burezi, ubuzima, ubucuruzi, siporo n'ikoranabuhanga.

hero.title: Guteza Imbere Abaturage ba Masoro
hero.subtitle: Guteza Imbere Abakobwa · Guteza Imbere Urubyiruko · Siporo n'Ubuzima Bwiza · Ikoranabuhanga n'Uburezi

mission.title: Intego Yacu
mission.body: Duteza imbere iterambere rirambye n'amahirwe ku bakobwa n'urubyiruko binyuze mu buzima bwiza, uburezi, n'ubucuruzi. Ikigo cyacu cy'abaturage i Masoro gifite ibibuga bya siporo, laboratwari ya mudasobwa, isomero, n'ibiro bishyigikira ibikorwa bitandukanye by'uburezi n'iterambere ry'ubukungu.
mission.imageAlt: Ikigo cy'Abaturage cya Isôoko i Masoro

programs.title: Porogaramu Zacu
programs.subtitle: Porogaramu eshanu zifatanije zigirira akamaro abaturage

cta.title: Fatanya Natwe mu Guteza Imbere Masoro
cta.text: Inkunga yawe ifasha abakobwa kwihangira imirimo, urubyiruko kuronka ubumenyi, n'imiryango gutera imbere.
